suctioned.definition:
v remove or draw away by the force of suction
v empty or clean (a body cavity) by the force of suction
suctioned.translation: v. 吸, 抽吸( suction的过去式和过去分词 )

suctioning.definition:
v remove or draw away by the force of suction
v empty or clean (a body cavity) by the force of suction
suctioning.translation: v. 吸, 抽吸( suction的现在分词 )

suctions.definition:
n a force over an area produced by a pressure difference
n the act of sucking
v remove or draw away by the force of suction
v empty or clean (a body cavity) by the force of suction
suctions.translation:
n. 吸, 抽吸( suction的名词复数 )
v. 吸, 抽吸( suction的第三人称单数 )

suctoria.definition:
n. pl. An order of Infusoria having the body armed with
   somewhat stiff, tubular processes which they use as suckers in
   obtaining their food. They are usually stalked.
n. pl. Same as Rhizocephala.

suctorial.definition: a. adapted for sucking or clinging by suction
suctorial.translation:
a. 会吸住的, 适于吸的, 有吸盘的
[医] 吸吮的

suctorian.definition:
n. A cartilaginous fish with a mouth adapted for suction,
   as the lampery.
n. One of the Suctoria.

suctorious.translation: a. 吸的, 有吸附的, 有吸盘的, 吸吮的
